description: Apply runahead execution from CPU microarchitecture to JSON parsing: when the parser stalls on a long-latency operation (number parsing, UTF-8 validation), continue parsing structurally ahead to prefetch structural indices and prime the cache. Like CPU runahead, the ahead-work generates prefetch hints, not committed state.
mathematical_formalization: Parsing operations with latencies L_i. When L_i > threshold, runahead for operations i+1..i+R. Cache hit improvement: Delta_hit = sum_{j=1}^R Pr[byte at tape[i+j] not in cache] * Pr[L_i > prefetch_latency]. For L1 miss penalty ~10 cycles, stride ~20 bytes: R=8 prefetches cover ~160 bytes ahead.
analogical_connections: CPU runahead execution (Mutlu 2003): execute past cache miss to generate prefetches, discard and re-execute on miss resolution
OS file readahead: prefetch subsequent blocks on sequential access detection
Speculative decoding in LLMs: generate tokens ahead of verification
implementation_hypothesis: In on-demand parser, when materializing a value, issue _mm_prefetch for next N structural index entries and corresponding input ranges. Implement lightweight runahead coroutine that walks structural tape ahead of main parser, issuing prefetches without modifying state.
experiment_seed: Instrument simdjson On-Demand for cache miss rates during materialization. Add software prefetching. Measure delta in cache misses and throughput on large files with cache-miss-heavy access patterns. Target: >15% throughput improvement.
